Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: NovaHealth discovery recap — quick priority pulse and SE/CS ask

Hi Samir — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and next steps so everything is in one place: 

- Attendees: Samir Rao (NovaHealth), Kimberly Park (Redwood AE), Marcus Lin (Redwood SE - on brief)
- Key problem: NovaHealth needs a way to run clinical notes summarization at scale with strict PII controls and <100ms tail latency for chat workflows.
- Current constraints: pilot budget allocated for Q3, security review in early June, procurement lead (TBD) needs SOC2 evidence and retention policy details.
- Hypothesis: Redwood Dedicated or Private (VPC) will be the best fit for their throughput + compliance needs; we should propose a short pilot focusing on 2 models and a KV-cache pattern to reduce token costs.

Action items / asks:
1) Samir: confirm priority/timing for pilot and who will own procurement signoff (name/email).
2) Redwood: send a short pilot proposal and SOC2 evidence (I attached precall notes + recording).
3) SE ask: Marcus, can you outline 2 potential model choices and an estimated cost/time for a 6-week pilot?

Attachments: precall-notes.txt (internal notes), discovery-recording.mp3 (20m)

I'll follow up in a week if I don't hear back — if your timeline shifted, a quick note is helpful so we don't re-contact at the wrong cadence.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

Kim —

I can do the week of 6/7. For the pilot I'd recommend:
- Option A: LlamaX-13B quantized for cheaper bursty inference + 95% of use cases.
- Option B: MPT-34B for higher quality on clinical summarization if latency constraints loosen.

Estimated infra/time: 2–3 GPUs (A100 class) for the pilot peak; setup + runbook ~10 dev-days, 3–4 weeks to a stable pilot. I'll prepare a 3-bullet summary you can paste into the bump.

LG,
Marcus

From CS perspective, two quick hooks that help pilot approval:
- Frame the pilot around a clear retention KPI: show how a 10% reduction in clinician read-time (via summarization) maps to X FTE savings and a 6–8 week ROI.
- Offer one 30-minute onboarding + one health-check at week 3 included for pilot signups; that lowers perceived risk for product teams.

If you want, I can draft the 1-paragraph ROI blurb. Also agree with Marcus on the demo options.

Thanks,
Monica
